claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-048
Date of Incident: September 3, 2021
Time of Incident: Approximately 1350 hours
Location: Orangethorpe Avenue / Buena Park Unified School District Office area, Buena Park, CA
Reporting Officer: Detective M. Torres
Badge Number: 6274
Subject: Raymond Dawson, Male, 61 years old
Officer(s): Detective M. Torres, Officer J. Cho
Witness(es): Female school bus driver (W-1, Jane Doe), various civilians
On September 3, 2021, at approximately 1350 hours, I was operating in an undercover capacity in a personal vehicle near the intersection of Orangethorpe Avenue and Beach Boulevard
I monitored radio traffic regarding a domestic violence suspect who had fired a weapon at a school bus
I was in plain clothes at the time: a black T-shirt, blue jeans, and a load bearing vest with a BPPD badge and a cloth patch reading "POLICE" on the front
On August 22, 2021, the subject had assaulted his wife, W-1, and their six-year-old son at the family residence
I had been briefed that the subject had broken W-1's wrist during the altercation
A restraining order was subsequently issued
a warrant for the subject's arrest was outstanding
Intelligence reports indicated the subject had expressed intent to harm W-1
an anonymous tipster had warned that the subject was armed
W-1 reported that while driving the school bus on Orangethorpe Avenue with students aboard, she observed the subject following her in a grey Chevrolet Tahoe
the subject blocked the bus's path
the subject exited his vehicle holding a chrome revolver
the subject aimed it at the bus
W-1 stated the subject screamed verbal threats including death threats directed at her
Unable to maneuver past the subject's vehicle, W-1 placed the bus in reverse to escape
As the bus reversed, the subject fired at least one round in the direction of the bus
Officer Efrain Rubalcava, who was in the vicinity, reported hearing a horn and observing the subject exit his vehicle and fire two shots toward the school bus
Officer Rubalcava activated his emergency equipment and pursued the subject
the subject returned to his vehicle and fled southbound
During the pursuit, the subject committed numerous traffic violations
the subject collided with a civilian vehicle that was in the left turn pocket
the civilian vehicle was a white Honda Accord
the civilian vehicle's driver sustained minor injuries
the subject then drove through the closed gate of the Buena Park Unified School District Office
entered the parking lot
rammed a parked vehicle
came to a stop
I arrived in the parking lot approximately 90 seconds after the subject stopped
Upon pulling up behind the subject's vehicle, I immediately observed the subject seated in the driver's seat with a black semi-automatic pistol visible in his left hand
I took cover behind my vehicle door and began issuing verbal commands
Officer Cho arrived seconds after me
The subject exited his vehicle holding the weapon in his right hand
He walked slowly toward the officers with what I would describe as a resigned expression
He pointed the weapon first in my direction, then toward Officer Cho
We both discharged our firearms
The subject fell to the ground but continued to hold the weapon
After determining the subject was no longer pointing the gun, we ceased fire
Total rounds fired: approximately eight by myself and six by Officer Cho
Officers rendered first aid at 1413 hours
OCFA paramedics arrived at 1420 hours
The subject was pronounced deceased at 1445 hours on scene
Body-worn camera footage (multiple officers)
Cartridge cases (multiple)
One (1) black pistol
Vehicle debris and school bus surveillance footage
Subject pronounced deceased on scene
W-1 and child passenger taken to safety
Civilian driver of Honda Accord treated at scene
Officer Signature: M. Torres
Date of Report: September 3, 2021
